body:
I miss the taste, the touch, the feel, the smell, everything about you.
I am now a mother and married, so I can never go back to you but oh how I miss you, there is nothing like you. Nothing or no one compares to you.
I loved being alone with you and having you all to myself, with you I don't want or need anything or anyone else.I don't need friends, food, love attention, I just need you, you are my everything. You believe in me and I believe in you.
This is my tribute to you, I miss you so but alas I love my son more.
P.S I love you but we can never be.
